name: Content Notes for Island Events
description: Before the main text of a new island event that may touch a sensitive subject, a short note names it, for example "Content note: Bereavement". It never says which outcome will come. The labels are: Child death, Pregnancy loss, Bereavement, Serious injury, Disappearance, Historical suffering, Emotional distress. A subject the content filters below have removed from that event is left out of its note. New events only (the Isola Grand Event Collection's); the game's own events are unchanged. Off by default; Owner's Defaults ticks it. **Unverified in play: the effect has not been tested live.**

needs_on.for: the new island events it acts on

behavior_changes: The first text of each new event that may touch a sensitive subject starts with "Content note: <labels>" (a variant of that text compiled into the event, shown while this row is installed).
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte, game file or save is changed: the row is only a name in the installed patches' list ("VVFP Installed Patches.txt") that Story / Cheat Upgrades reads.
The game's own island events, their text and their chances are never changed: it acts on the added events only.
evidence_status: the compiled events' conditions and effects pinned in tests/test_event_content.py; runtime/player confirmation pending
